data: Apple reported fiscal 2025 net income of about $112.0 billion for the year ended September 27, 2025. NVIDIA reported about $72.9 billion for its fiscal 2025, which ended January 26, 2025. Apple's figure is about 1.5 times NVIDIA's (112.0 / 72.9 ≈ 1.54). The two companies use different fiscal calendars, so the periods don't line up exactly. I'm working from memory, so verify both figures against the companies' 10-K filings before relying on them.
